messages:
Kevin: Quick heads-up — product/partnerships sync for a coordinated announcement with Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus (vector). Want to align marketplace bundles, HW validation plan (Aurora partner), and SI handoffs. Draft timeline below, need owners and risks.
Maria: Thanks Kevin — can you drop the timeline + any embargo windows? If press/partner marketing is involved we need lead time for assets.
Kevin: Timeline:
- Week 0: partner legal + listing requirements check
- Week 1: integration QA & CI pass on sample dataset
- Week 2: marketplace listing + SKU + pricing confirmed
- Week 3: joint press dry-run + embargo lock
- Week 4: go-live (staged rollout)
Risks: data residency for EU customers, HW firmware compatibility on Aurora nodes, SI enablement docs not ready.
Amanda: @Maria re assets — marketing can produce co-branded kit but we need logo approvals from Snowflake/Databricks. That's usually 5 business days.
Leo: On the infra side: we need to validate continuous-batching behavior with Milvus vector retrieval at typical seq lengths. I can run a soak on staging; ETA 3 days once I get the sample dataset.
Oliver: I can coordinate SI enablement with Tenzor Systems. Suggest a one-hour enablement webinar week before go-live and an onboarding playbook (short).
Maria: Can someone create the triage matrix for compliance, infra, marketplace, and PR? I want a single source we can pass to partner PMs.
Kevin: Created a quick checklist snippet — please fill: 
```
Marketplace checklist:
- Listing owner: 
- SKU/Bundling: single bundle vs add-on
- Pricing floor: 
- Legal/COI signoff: 
- EU residency flag: true/false
- Preview URL: 
- Embargo date/time: 
```
Partner Ops Bot: Reminder: vendor logo approval workflow started for Snowflake at 2024-08-19T14:00Z. Status: pending.
Amanda: I filled in marketing lead (me) + PR contact (sam PR) in the doc. Also added a note: we should avoid mentioning specific latency numbers until infra soak completes.
Leo: Starting soak now on the staging cluster with Milvus v2.6 + our connector. Posting results here in ~48h.
Kevin: Owners so far: infra = Leo, marketing = Amanda, SI = Oliver, legal = Maria. Can legal confirm EU residency check by EOD tomorrow?
Maria: Confirmed — legal will run EU residency and data flow checklist, deliverable by 2024-08-21 18:00 UTC.
Oliver: I'll draft the enablement agenda and share slides in the doc. Also flagging SSO testing with Databricks connectors.
Amanda: FYI, we should decide if we list a combined bundle (Redwood + Connector + Milvus) or list Redwood and add partner integrations as add-ons. Costing impacts marketplace gating.
Kevin: Good point. Can finance weigh in if combined bundle affects revenue share? @Finance (ping)
Partner Ops Bot: Action item created: "announce-orch-triage" assigned to Kevin, due 2024-08-22.
Oliver: One more: HW partner Aurora needs firmware version >= 1.9 for our optimized kernels. Leo — can you confirm compatibility matrix?
Leo: Will run compatibility check as part of soak — will post matrix by tomorrow afternoon.
Kevin: Great. If nobody objects I'll convert this thread into the official triage doc and loop partner PMs after legal signoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: No objections. Please include a short rollback checklist for the staged rollout.
Amanda: I'll add rollback steps and customer comms templates.
Kevin: Closing loop — next sync Wed 09:30 PT. I’ll send calendar invite once doc is updated.
Oliver: Thanks — will prep SI invite list.
Kevin: End of thread.
